# BB00607 {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Most Patient, the Most Patient, the Possessor of Glory and Eternity

In the presence of the honored grandmother, father, maternal uncle, in the year 14, and those who are waiting, and the estate, it is mentioned that: Praise be to God for His manifestation in all things, and God, and other than [God]. Yet unto Him do I commit my affairs, and He is the best of helpers. And verily the Glory from the Book of God be upon all the male believers. First Shin-Nun. And verily the Glory from the Book of God be upon all the female believers.
